$comment: M13. The second half of an arrival page: who is there, and the page's last line. Holes: watcher, client (forms: full, the presence line as M11 wrote it; activity, what they were doing and nothing else; placed, what they were doing put by the prop from `pool`; recall, the client's recall action), others (everybody the sheet has not placed: forms full, placed, list with `text` framing {list}), tell (the observation, when the sheet text has not said it), views (the detective's view of anybody else), answer (what came of the walk). Card holes: trait (character, kind look, of watcher/tell/client), street (character, kind street), greet (the client's greeting). Slots: {watcher}, {client}, {tell} and each's .he .He .him .his .His .man .doing .act .sight .hour; {tell.tie} ('the woman who had found Sirkin'); {prop}, {prop.near}, {trait}. Whatever the sheet does not place goes in before the close: nobody present is ever left out, and the observation always lands. One joke slot a sheet.

sheets.name: The room looks at me
sheets.notes: Sheet A, the blessed golden. The watcher sizes the detective up, the room reacts, and the tell is the one person who didn't look. The watcher's trait (eyes that went to the door) sets up the tell.

parts.text: Nobody looked up except the one person paid to.
alt: One head came up. It was paid to.
Looking up was one person’s job in there.
Nobody looked up. Well, one did, but that was business.

parts.text: The only one who didn’t look at me at all was {tell}. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.
alt: {tell}, {tell.tie}, was {tell.doing}, and didn’t look my way once.
{tell} was {tell.doing} as if I hadn’t come in. That was {tell.tie}.
{tell} didn’t look up once, not even when the door went. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.

callback: I caught myself in the glass behind {prop} and looked away first. Somebody in there had to.
I let {prop} be. It had been there longer than me, and it would be there after.
I found a place near {prop}. It was the one spot in the room nobody wanted, and after a minute I could see why.
Between {prop} and me, only one of us looked as if it belonged there, and it wasn’t me.
plain: I found a place where I could see the door. Everybody else in there had had the same idea first.
It was that kind of room. Everybody in it was minding their own business, and I was the only one there to mind everybody else’s.
The room went back to what it had been doing. I tried to look like part of it and didn’t fool anybody.
I took my hat off. Nobody offered to hang it up, which in a room like that counts as manners.
quiet: I found a place by the wall where I could see all of them.
I stayed where I was and let the room settle.
I took a spot near the door and waited to be noticed.

sheets.name: One thing in the room
sheets.notes: Sheet B. A single thing dominates. People are placed by it, so the room has a geography instead of a list, and the close pays it off. Needs the arrival sheet to have bound a prop.

pool: as far from {prop} as the room allowed, which I suspected was the point
at the far end, well away from {prop}
in plain sight of {prop}, and not looking at {prop.it} once

callback: I had a good long look at {prop}. It had a good long look back, and neither of us learned anything.
Everybody in there had arranged themselves around {prop}. I did the same; it seemed to be the custom.
I stood where I could see {prop} and everybody near {prop.it}. That’s most of the job, and I’m good at standing.
plain: Nobody asked what I wanted. In that room it was a courtesy.
I found the one spot nobody had claimed. There’s always one, and it’s always in the draught.
The room took me in and said nothing about it. I’ve had worse welcomes, most of them at home.
I stood there until I stopped being new. In that room it took about a minute.
quiet: I found a spot where I could see them all.
I stood a little way off and took them in.
Nobody made room for me, and I didn’t ask for any.

sheets.name: The client waves me over
sheets.notes: Sheet C. The client is present and the page leans on her; the others are seen over her shoulder, and the free rundown is set up as the next beat of the scene. Its last line is always the rundown's setup, never a callback: that line is what makes the free choice read as the next beat.

alt: {client} had spotted me first.
{client} had been watching the door for me.
By the time I found {client}, {client.he} had found me.

parts.text: From where {client.he} was you could see all of it, {prop} included: {list}.
From where {client.he} was you could see all of it: {list}.

alt: Past {client.his} shoulder I could see {tell}, {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.
{tell} was in the room too, {tell.tie}. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}.
{tell} was there as well, {tell.doing}. That was {tell.tie}.

plain: {client.He} looked like {client.he} was about to tell me who everybody was, whether I asked or not.
{client.He} had the look of somebody about to tell me who everybody was, and what {client.he} thought of each of them.
{client.He} had the whole room sorted and labelled, and was only waiting for me to sit down.
{client.He} leaned in. I was about to be introduced to the whole room, whether it liked it or not.
quiet: {client.He} waited for me to sit down.
{client.He} moved over so I could sit.
I sat down where {client.he} could talk without raising {client.his} voice.

sheets.name: The one I came to see
sheets.notes: The tell first, then the room around them. For a room with more than one person in it, where the page ties somebody to the case.

parts.text: I saw {tell} before {tell.he} saw me, which is the right way round. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.
alt: I found {tell} first, which is how I like it. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.
{tell} hadn’t noticed me yet. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.
My eyes went to {tell} first. {tell.He} was {tell.doing}, {tell.tie}.

plain: Nobody made room for me. I made some anyway. It’s a skill, like parking.
I stood where I could see all of them. It’s the only way I know to be sure of anything in a room.
I kept my hat on and my eyes open, which is most of what I know how to do.
I took the spot with the best view. It was also the draughtiest, which is how you know.
quiet: I stood where I could see all of them.
I found a place near the door and stayed in it.
I kept to the wall and let them get used to me.

sheets.name: Somebody minding the place
sheets.notes: One person in the room, the one who keeps it, and nobody the page ties to the case.

parts.text: {watcher.He} was the only one there, and had the look of somebody who liked it that way.
alt: {watcher.He} had the place to {watcher.him}self, or had until I came in.
There was nobody else there, and {watcher.he} didn’t seem to be missing anybody.
I was the first company {watcher.he}’d had in a while, and {watcher.he} wasn’t sure {watcher.he} wanted any.

plain: That suited me. One person is about as many as I can listen to at that hour.
It made for a short list. I’ve worked with shorter, but not by choice.
Two was a crowd in there, and I was the second.
It was a quiet room. I did my best not to spoil it.
quiet: It was just the two of us, then.
That made two of us in there.
I had {watcher.him} to myself.

sheets.name: Nobody home
sheets.notes: Nobody in the room at all.

parts.text: There was nobody there. I checked twice, which is once more than an empty room needs.
alt: The place was empty. I said good evening anyway, in case it was listening.
There was nobody there, unless you count me, and most people don’t.
The room was empty, which made it the best company I’d had all night.
plain: There was nobody there. I looked twice to be sure.
The place was empty. Nobody came while I stood in it.
There was nobody there. Nothing said anybody was expected.
I stood in it a minute anyway. Sometimes a room will tell you things if you give it a chance to get bored.
I let the quiet have its say. It didn’t have much.
I waited to see if anybody would come back. Nobody did, which was at least consistent of them.
I stood there long enough to be sure. Then I stood there a bit longer, to be thorough.
quiet: I stood in it a minute before I did anything else. Nobody came.
I let my eyes get used to the dark. Nobody came in while I did.
I waited a minute, in case anybody came back. Nobody did.

sheets.name: Faces in the room
sheets.notes: People in the room, no watcher and no one the page ties to the case: who is there, said the M11 way, and a last word.

plain: Nobody looked twice at me. At that hour, in that neighbourhood, a man in a hat is furniture.
I let the room get used to me. It didn’t take long. Rooms like that have seen worse.
Nobody asked who I was. In that part of town, not asking is how people say hello.
I stood by the wall like I’d been hired to hold it up.
quiet: Nobody looked up when I came in.
I found a place by the wall and took them in.
Nobody asked who I was.
